name: Form 4 Mathematics: Integration
subject: Mathematics
learningObjectives: By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to integrate polynomial functions
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to find the area under a curve using integration
learningActivities: Demonstration: teacher integrates 2x and 3x^2 using the reverse of the power rule
Guided practice: learners integrate various polynomials
Application: learners find areas under curves
keyPoints: Integration is the reverse of differentiation
The integral of x^n is x^(n+1)/(n+1) + c
The area under a curve between two points is found by definite integration
lessonEvaluation: Learners integrate five functions and find one area under a curve.
teacherReflection: Good progress. Emphasise the constant of integration next lesson.
